source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    period = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    first = grid[1][0] if len(grid) > 1 else grid[0][0]

            if row[i] != 0:
                i += 1

            while i < n and row[i] == 0:

                    if c == r:

                    row[c] = value
            else:

                for c in range(start, end):
                    value = expected
                    if c == r:
                        value = (expected - 2) % period + 1
                    row[c] = value
                    expected = expected % period + 1
    return out
'''
